name: Auto Outfitting
author: Mjolniar
description: Adds an Optimal goal to the refit screen's autofit: the strongest build for the ship from the weapons, fighters and hullmods you actually have, scored from combat numbers: damage against shields, armor and hull, flux, range and special effects. Build style: Balanced, Anti-shield, Anti-armor or Hull killer (LunaLib, or data/config/jonahs_auto_outfitting.json).
